en.name: Gregory III
en.summary: The last pope to seek imperial ratification of his election from Constantinople, who turned instead to the Frankish ruler Charles Martel for protection against the Lombards.
en.body: Gregory III continued his predecessor's opposition to Byzantine iconoclasm, formally excommunicating those who destroyed sacred images. Facing renewed Lombard pressure on Roman territory and receiving no help from an estranged Constantinople, he appealed directly to the Frankish leader Charles Martel for military protection — an early step in the shift of papal political alliance from the Byzantine East toward the Frankish West that would culminate decades later in Charlemagne's coronation.
